definitions.gloss: cross jump (jump rope, crossing the arms)
definitions.explanation: A jump-rope technique in which the jumper crosses their arms in front of the body just before the rope passes underfoot, and keeps them crossed for the following jumps; alternating crossed and open jumps is あや{跳|と}び. A staple trick-jumping move in Japanese elementary school jump-rope routines.

examples.japanese: {交差|こうさ}{跳|と}び⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}する→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧。
{交差|こうさ}{跳|と}び⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交差|こうさ}→交差：00246_kousa⟧⟦させて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{跳|と}ぶ→跳ぶ：19597_tobu⟧⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧だ。
examples.english: The cross jump is a technique where you jump while crossing your arms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何回|なんかい}→何回：08497_nankai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}して→練習する：22991_renshuusuru⟧、⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{交差|こうさ}{跳|と}び⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{跳|と}べる→跳ぶ：19597_tobu⟧ようになった。
examples.english: After practicing many times, I was finally able to do the cross jump repeatedly without stopping.

notes:
{交差|こうさ}{跳|と}び is a trick jump in which the arms are crossed in front of the body right before the rope passes under the feet; alternating crossed and open jumps is あや{跳|と}び instead. It requires more coordination than the basic ⟦{前|まえ}{跳|と}び→前跳び：30927_maetobi⟧ and is often one of the first "tricks" children learn.

- ⟦{片足|かたあし}{跳|と}び→片足跳び：30930_kataashitobi⟧: single-leg jump
